content.title: Alibaba & Baidu gain on Trump's China tone, Intel downgraded
content.description:
Josh Lipton and Allie Canal outline some of the top stories investors are watching on Monday, including Chinese stocks — like Alibaba (BABA), Baidu (BIDU), and JD.com (JD) — gaining on President Trump's softened tariff threats on China, and top analyst calls — like Intel's (INTC) downgrade and Estee Lauder's (EL) upgrade.
